text: At just 24 years old, I would have the distinction of becoming the youngest councilmember in El Cajon’s history. A lifelong resident, my campaign is rooted in my experiences growing up in a city that hasn’t received the investment it deserves. Having lived close to poverty most of my life, I comprehend the realities faced by working families — not merely as a rhetorical point, but as a personal narrative. I’ve promised my family and supporters to always stand with the politically voiceless, the underrepresented, and frontline workers who keep our city thriving.

Fortunately, my journey opened doors that many children around me never had the chance to enter. Through mentorships and impressing key leaders, I went from Disney sets to Harvard classrooms. I’ve learned that talent exists everywhere — opportunity does not. I realize I am no different from my peers; I was simply given access to opportunities they should have had too.

I will fight to give your children the foundation they need to succeed, establish political term limits, streamline small-business growth, create a homeless crisis response team, and oppose additional taxation.
Visit our website to witness a new generation stepping into local government, fighting for a different future.

text: I will bring more than 33 years of proven leadership, public safety experience, and problem-solving to the El Cajon City Council. I served 28 years with the San Diego Police Department, retiring as an Assistant Chief, and five years as Chief of Police for the City of Coronado.

I’m running because I believe El Cajon’s best days are ahead. Every resident deserves to feel safe, every business deserves the opportunity to succeed, and every family deserves a city they are proud to call home.

I will work to attract new businesses, expand dining and entertainment options, and create good-paying jobs that strengthen our local economy. I support redeveloping Parkway Plaza into a vibrant destination with pride of ownership housing, jobs, and new opportunities, while revitalizing downtown in a way that preserves its unique character.

A strong economy provides the resources needed to maintain excellent police, fire protection, parks, roads, and other essential city services. I will bring experienced leadership, a commitment to public safety, and a common-sense approach to responsible growth to help build a safer, stronger, and more prosperous El Cajon for today and future generations.

text: I’m running to bring a fresh perspective to the City Council focusing on safe neighborhoods, lowering the cost of living, addressing homelessness, and ensuring a transparent government that’s accountable to the voters. I hope to earn your vote through my focus on these local, quality-of-life issues.
The Council needs to focus on these local priorities–not on wasteful misadventures like failed lawsuits or buying Parkway Plaza.

For 5 years on the Public Safety Facility Financing Oversight Committee, I’ve ensured your taxpayer dollars are well spent on critical public safety infrastructure like fire station upgrades and police equipment.
I’ll bring 13 years of leadership experience in business and healthcare to partner with all community members to bring El Cajon into a new era.
